display_title: You Must Turn on the Broadcast
description:
Do-Yun is an ordinary person. He's a faceless, part-time fitting model to be exact.

But one day... While he's enjoying his free time on a Saturday afternoon, he gets a request from his friend Chang-Hyeok, a gaming streamer, to participate in a 'broadcast collab' at his place. However...

\[I told you to shut up, you b\*stards! It's too loud.\]
“… … .”

The atmosphere of the broadcast is not normal. Will Do-Yun be able to finish the broadcast safely? 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*(Note: This is a one-shot promotional webtoon for the web novel of the same name.*
